body: `calendarSyncDisabled` only considers `calendarSyncLoading` and `needsReauth`, but the page also supports a `needsReconsent` state (shown via the “Calendar permissions required” banner). When `needsReconsent` is true, the Calendar sync button should be disabled/hidden to avoid triggering a sync that will fail due to missing permissions. Consider passing `needsReconsent` into `SyncControls` and incorporating it into `calendarSyncDisabled` (and optionally showing a helper message).

The sync indicator icon is used as a meaningful status signal but doesn’t have an accessible label (or a visually-hidden text alternative). Elsewhere in the UI the same Cloud icon is given an `aria-label` (e.g. in `JournalListItem`). Add an accessible label for this icon (and ensure it’s not announced redundantly as part of the link text).
```suggestion
                className='h-4 w-4 shrink-0 opacity-80'
```

```suggestion
    await page.route(
      '**/api/integrations/google/contacts/sync-history**',
```
